title: Benchmark drift, contamination and comparability
scope: Eight benchmark-measurement provenance collections: five new families and three existing-family enrichments. Preserves source repairs, affected-run identification, regrading, rerunning and corrected publication as distinct states. No actual evaluation was executed.
source_snapshot_limit: Small complete pinned Git source files were verified independently; partial source rows and web captures are not represented as whole-file or historical-archive byte identities. Source receipts, programs, question corpora, outputs and logs are not included.
third_party_rights: Source-specific rights remain separate for software, task content, outputs, logs, reports and third-party material. Public availability is not blanket reuse clearance.
verdict: Retain eight qualified research collections: five new families and three enrichments. Prioritize EvalPlus revision provenance, lm-eval measurement changes and LiveBench retroactive revisions. Preserve measurement identity and evidence-specific contamination semantics; one EvalPlus mapping specification remains deferred, with no benchmark run or operational admission.

baseline_inventory.scope: Frozen 64-family inventory and relevant historical, algorithmic-efficiency, claim/result, model-identity and negative-replication catalogs. Historical source-review baseline is distinct from later integration base.

novelty_summary.note: Relative to 64-source inventory and reviewed catalogs; lm-eval software remains a distinct provenance family from CRP002 archived downstream results.

interpretation_guards: Preserve original measurement and corrected publication as linked events; never overwrite historical score lineage.
A same-name benchmark/model is insufficient for comparability. Require item content, task/scoring/harness revisions, model execution identity and exact inference conditions.
Scoring-only regrading, fresh inference, task-population change, uncertainty-only correction and publication metadata revision are different event types.
Training exposure observed in controlled intervention, training-data overlap, behavioral memorization evidence, statistical non-generalization diagnostics and suspicion are distinct evidence classes.
A non-detection is not evidence of no exposure. Fresh temporal cohorts are not automatically equally difficult or unseen for every model.
Retain eligible, attempted, validly graded and per-metric denominators, missingness and aggregation weights separately.
Source rights are artifact-specific. Public availability and software license do not clear all tasks, outputs, logs or reports.
No pooled universal capability curve, failure census or p(doom) inference is created.

collections.name: ConStat contamination diagnostics and retained non-detections
collections.historical_coverage: Table commit and paper v1 May 25 2024; no live refresh schedule established.

rights.repository: Apache-2.0 at pinned table revision; covers repository material subject to separate upstream components
rights.external_benchmark_output_archives: Not acquired or cleared; README discourages republication

limitations: Observational diagnostics concern non-generalizing performance, not direct training-corpus inspection. Controlled intentionally exposed models are a separate evidence class.
Non-detection under rephrasing does not establish absence of exposure; retain both rows.
estimated_contamination is estimated counterfactual benchmark performance, not probability or contamination fraction; not verified decontaminated capability.
Raw p-values remain raw. Paper applies Benjamini–Hochberg by benchmark/type for reference-model tests; do not rerun correction on only the displayed pair.
Tables omit item IDs/denominators; loader deduplicates doc_id and truncates model arrays to minimum available length. Equal length is not proof of matched item identity.
Repository declares customized lm-eval v0.4.1 fork. Later upstream fixes cannot be applied retroactively without code-path evidence.
Released checkpoints and deliberately fine-tuned contamination models coexist in the tables; they must not be pooled as identical populations.
collections.duplicate_evidence: Two reference tests reuse the same benchmark model performance. Tables, figures and paper are presentations of one study, not independent replications.
collections.decision: Retain only as research candidate diagnostics qualifying measurements; retain nulls, test construction and unresolved denominator/model-execution provenance.

corrections.finding: Before/after leaderboard snapshots identify published score revisions, not proven reruns, unchanged model bytes or an isolated denominator treatment. Tag creation, dataset notice, result commits and unknown inference dates differ.

The maximum task-level sample count is a lower bound on documents evaluated. Pinned evaluator text explicitly retains a size-weighted group over-weighting problem when metrics have unequal populations.

Current HF viewer is a subset summary (seven tasks, three categories); full latest downloadable coverage and the intake's April 2025 last-upload claim were not reverified because history fetch failed.
Errata's universal-unsolvability statement does not erase denominator effects. Parse 11/2/4 actual IDs, retaining stale 7/2/1 prose; changing populations require separate scores.
TH1.1 includes GPT-4-32k-0314 and o1-preview estimates on new tasks but old Vivaria infrastructure. A homogeneous-series claim needs per-model scaffold verification.
March 6 pipeline synchronization changes more than regularization, including runs/models. Its full output delta cannot be interpreted as the isolated regularization effect.

NR008 already verifies the selected 138-task audit and later Pro recommendation event. Reuse that identity; gold 126 validation examples and N=477 system-card denominator are different evidence/populations.
Paper and HF card give 1205; legacy page describes 1000. No manifest proves a uniform 1000→1205 transition. Human-extraction gain is a scoring ablation.

ConStat's estimated_contamination field is an estimated counterfactual performance score. Raw p-values are neither adjusted significance labels nor probabilities of training exposure; non-detection is retained.
ConStat used a customized lm-eval v0.4.1 fork. A later upstream fix does not establish that its actual study results followed the affected path.

follow_up_prompts.title: Map one EvalPlus revision
follow_up_prompts.prompt: Use the already-verified April 2024 MBPP+ metadata, migration text and two-model score extracts. Describe a revision-event mapping only; do not implement an adapter or run benchmarks. If evidence is unavailable, read at most 12 small primary metadata/text artifacts totalling 300 KB, stopping at any access denial. Pins: migration https://github.com/evalplus/evalplus/blob/3de226896daa67b54e2683eb6e5f6840ce66018a/tools/mbpp/fix_v010.py; results before https://github.com/evalplus/evalplus.github.io/blob/3b9f5b48c92a492a48fde6c0e1bffb9295812caf/results.json and after https://github.com/evalplus/evalplus.github.io/blob/65db7ffdb66ae3fee800bee8d998b412f0a6e648/results.json. Scope CodeGen-16B and CodeGen-2B, 21 removals, 18 prompt edits and 16 metric slots. Preserve two nulls, tag-object versus commit identities, artifact rights, and unknown output/checkpoint/inference links. Stop with the specification and unresolved fields; no archives, model outputs or repository edits.

Use at most six public metadata/text reads and 200 KB. Determine whether the exact scoring, few-shot or group-weighting path matches a documented repair. Require metric-specific counts and actual fork/commit linkage; keep CRP002's unresolved evaluator revision unresolved if no evidence closes it. Classify scoring-only regrade, new inference required, unaffected or unknown, without running source code, fetching outputs, or treating all earlier results as invalid. If no downstream result is supplied, return the missing fields and stop.
